mcps.name: Stripe MCP
mcps.summary: Stripe's official local and hosted MCP interface for Stripe APIs and support knowledge.
mcps.installation: Run npx -y @stripe/mcp with a restricted Stripe API key, or connect to https://mcp.stripe.com and authorize with OAuth.
authentication: Restricted Stripe API key (local)
OAuth (hosted)
geographies: Stripe-supported countries; exact MCP-specific coverage unknown

capabilities.name: Stripe API tools
capabilities.summary: Provider documentation describes Stripe API operations; exact enabled tools depend on restricted-key permissions.

capabilities.name: search_stripe_documentation
capabilities.summary: Searches Stripe documentation and support knowledge.

capabilities.name: Treasury tools
capabilities.summary: Optional tools can move money, pay bills, and create or manage cards; human approval is strongly recommended.

limitations: Initialization is blocked without a Stripe key or OAuth authorization.
Tool visibility is permission-dependent.
Treasury and payment tools can change financial state and were not invoked.

test.notes: Package started without credentials and exited before initialization with an explicit API-key requirement. No credentials were supplied.

sources.title: Stripe AI MCP source and package instructions

mcps.name: Saldo MCP
mcps.summary: A local-first, read-only banking connector for Swedish and Nordic accounts using Enable Banking.
mcps.installation: Run npx saldo-mcp init, configure an Enable Banking restricted application, link a bank with BankID, sync, then register the MCP client.
authentication: Enable Banking application ID and private-key path
Bank consent via BankID
geographies: Nordic countries supported by Enable Banking
institutions: Linked Nordic banks; exact list discoverable with the institutions command

capabilities.name: get_balances
capabilities.summary: Reads cached balances for linked bank accounts.

capabilities.name: get_transactions
capabilities.summary: Reads transactions with date, amount, and account filters.

capabilities.name: spending_by_category
capabilities.summary: Summarizes spending by local labels or counterparty.

capabilities.name: set_transaction_labels
capabilities.summary: Writes category labels only to the encrypted local cache; it cannot modify the bank.

capabilities.name: label-transactions
capabilities.summary: Guides local transaction labeling.

limitations: Requires a Nordic bank account and user-mediated bank consent.
Payment initiation is explicitly absent, but local labels are mutable.
No runtime attempt was made because account linking requires an external bank identity and private key.

test.notes: Not started: setup requires a real Nordic bank identity and Enable Banking application material, which are outside the safe test boundary.

authentication: No API key documented
geographies: Markets covered by Yahoo Finance; exact geography unknown
institutions: Public issuers and exchanges represented by Yahoo Finance

capabilities.summary: OHLCV history; parameters include ticker, period, and interval.

limitations: Community adapter, not an official Yahoo product.

The connection attempt failed because the host lacked python3.12-venv/ensurepip; no elevated package installation was attempted.

test.notes: The npx launcher selected Python 3.12 but could not create its isolated environment because ensurepip/python3.12-venv was unavailable.

upstreamProviders: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR public APIs
